highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 preview fixes Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time deployment failures.
highlights_body: It also refreshes bundled image and text dependencies and hardens native assets.

bullets.lead: Linux ARM64 and AOT startup failures fixed
bullets.detail: Linux ARM64 packages include the required fontconfig runtime library, and AOT applications work when reflection is disabled.

bullets.lead: Bundled dependencies and native protections refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libpng, libwebp, brotli, and native binary hardening settings.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Native binary hardening for Windows and Linux

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 delivers servicing fixes for AOT and Linux ARM64 along with dependency updates.
